author: Donna Ridge Ingle
text: I'm in the same boat as you.  Have the same phone.  Always, ALWAYS have alarms going off on the first night of placement, that is a Libre issue.  But I have lots of signal loss when I'm holding my phone, and my phone jumps to 4G a service if I do anything online, which causes the Libre to lose signal.  Went by my phone carrier, and they told me they reset it and the problem should stop.  It didn't.  I think they blew smoke, frankly.  Went back later and they said something about the Sim card most likely getting scratched with continued movement of my phone (HUH??!?!?) causing the signal to break up.  Told me I could fix it with a new phone and plan upgrade that would make my bill go up about $100/.mo.  I passed on that one.  Funny, my problem started about the time they introduced a new plan option with stronger signal.  I've learned to close the app and the Bluetooth, wait a couple of minutes and turn them both back on. Things that make you go Hmmm....
